quotes.speaker: Dennis Schröder
quotes.summary_phrase: Dennis Schröder on his difficult stint with the Houston Rockets
quotes.excerpt: They had no structure, no real GM who emphasizes what is important for professionals.
quotes.quote: They had no structure, no real GM who emphasizes what is important for professionals.

quotes.speaker: Dennis Schröder
quotes.summary_phrase: Dennis Schröder on James Harden's generational talent
quotes.excerpt: James Harden is generational talent, one of the best to ever play.
quotes.quote: James Harden is generational talent, one of the best to ever play. Of course he is getting older now, but he is still doing it on such a high level. People don't understand how hard it is.

quotes.speaker: Dennis Schröder
quotes.summary_phrase: Dennis Schröder on his overall rating in NBA 2K
quotes.excerpt: It doesn't matter in my career where I played and what I put up, I was never over 81.
quotes.quote: It doesn't matter in my career where I played and what I put up, I was never over 81. How is that possible?

quotes.speaker: Dennis Schröder
quotes.summary_phrase: Dennis Schröder on his preference for soccer over NBA 2K
quotes.excerpt: I don't really play it though, to be honest. I'm a FIFA guy, soccer.
quotes.quote: I don't really play it though, to be honest. I'm a FIFA guy, soccer. I used to play FIFA against him, my brother. We never played 2K.

quotes.speaker: Dennis Schröder
quotes.summary_phrase: Dennis Schröder on how NBA contracts should function like soccer
quotes.excerpt: I would do it like soccer. When soccer got a contract and they are talking about transfer fees.
quotes.quote: I would do it like soccer. When soccer got a contract and they are talking about transfer fees, both of them got to agree. The team and the player have to agree when they make a final move to this place. Both of them have to agree on it, and that's what I would do with the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Dennis Schröder
quotes.summary_phrase: Dennis Schröder on implementing bonus points in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Pro soccer players, they get money for every point. I would love that in the NBA too.
quotes.quote: Pro soccer players, they get money for every point. I would love that in the NBA too. Assists and points would mess everything up like the basketball skill, but for winning, I think that's a good.

quotes.speaker: Dennis Schröder
quotes.summary_phrase: Dennis Schröder on the role of Adam Silver as Commissioner
quotes.excerpt: He's the commissioner. He got so many people under him probably who are pitching him to him.
quotes.quote: He's the commissioner. He got so many people under him probably who are pitching him to him, you know, and then he says, either he want to do it or he don't want to do it.

quotes.speaker: Dennis Schröder
quotes.summary_phrase: Dennis Schröder on the importance of consistency in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: First off, you got to do a constant, you got to be consistent.
quotes.quote: First off, you got to do a constant, you got to be consistent. Right now with the national team, for example, we do all our pregame. When we because we driving, not with the team, we always go like an hour before because then I can lift weights, shoot a lot more, and we always like put that on Twitch so people can see the behind the scenes.

quotes.speaker: Dennis Schröder
quotes.summary_phrase: Dennis Schröder on his experience streaming with Malik Beasley
quotes.excerpt: I put Malik on to streaming and YouTube videos. I was the first guy in NBA.
quotes.quote: I put Malik on to streaming and YouTube videos. I was the first guy in NBA who did YouTube videos. And that's because of him. He told me, yo, like we have to do.
